rules.name: Unexpected Process Execution from Web Directory
rules.description: Behavioral detection rules for unknown zero-day exploitation patterns
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "zero_day" or Message contains "" | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3
